payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the frog within the toilet bowl read visually as occupying the bowl, rather than as a flat image placed over its interior?
node.criteria: Pass if the bowl frog's position and visible relation to the bowl interior make it read as situated in the bowl (for example, bowl-relative depth, overlap with the rim/interior, or apparent contact); fail if it clearly reads as a flat overlay on the bowl interior rather than situated there. Do not require photorealism or any particular technique. Unknown only if the visual relation cannot be judged.
node.source_quote: Put a frog in the toilet
node.endpoint: The frog reads as situated within the toilet bowl, not merely superimposed over its interior.
node.necessity: Being in the toilet entails more than appearing somewhere in the bowl's image area; this checks the requested spatial placement while avoiding a style or photorealism requirement.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the source, the edited image adds a frog inside the open toilet bowl. It sits within the bowl opening, below and partly framed by the white rim, with its body and feet overlapping the visible interior, so it reads as situated in the bowl rather than merely pasted onto the bowl image area.
